build_speech2speech_fleurs_dataset: build a Speech2SpeechFleursDatasetBuilder to assemble speech-to-speech data from the google/fleurs HuggingFace dataset
iterate_fleurs_audio_samples: iterate audio samples from a specific language in the FLEURS dataset using Speech2SpeechFleursDatasetBuilder
build_speech2text_gigaspeech_dataset: build a Speech2TextGigaspeechDatasetBuilder to assemble speech-to-text data from the speechcolab/gigaspeech HuggingFace dataset
iterate_gigaspeech_audio_samples: iterate audio samples from a specific language in the Gigaspeech dataset using Speech2TextGigaspeechDatasetBuilder
encode_speech_with_tokenizer: encode speech waveform with a SpeechTokenizer to produce discrete speech units
